rationale: Dylan and Peter are both Palo Alto-based founders solving endemic scaling problems through AI—Dylan in career guidance (1 coach to 2000 students) and Peter in clinical health diagnostics via wearables and deep learning. While their domains differ, they share a complementary skill set: Dylan brings GTM expertise and founder-level technical curiosity (Python, TypeScript), while Peter brings 18+ years of deep ML and embedded systems experience (Python, C, Swift) and clinical validation through top-tier publishing. Their conversation could surface how AI-first product design scales across different verticals.
intro_message: Dylan Bryan, meet Peter Kuhar — both building AI-powered solutions to systemic bottlenecks (career coaching and clinical diagnostics), and you'd benefit from comparing how you're each scaling ML models across consumer and clinical use cases.
